Alireza Kaveh Begins Publishing on IMDb

Published on: November 26, 2025

Alireza Kaveh Begins Publishing on IMDb

Alireza Kaveh Begins Publishing His Research and Critical Writings on IMDb
TEHRAN — Iranian author and film theorist Alireza Kaveh has begun publishing selected research notes and critical writings on IMDb, extending his ongoing efforts to document overlooked aspects of Iranian cinema within a globally accessible reference platform.

Kaveh’s decision to use IMDb as one of his publication channels follows years of archival and analytical work across multiple fields, including genre theory, cinematic taxonomy, and viewership studies. His contributions now appear within IMDb’s internal contributor workflow, where his submitted research materials are reviewed and integrated into the platform’s public database.

His recent descriptive entry on Parastuha Be Laneh Barmigardand (1964) marks the first step toward presenting underrepresented Iranian films and filmmakers to a wider international audience. The bilingual note (Persian and English) offers contextual insights into the film’s position within Iran’s early social melodrama tradition.
Readers can access Kaveh’s current contributions through his IMDb review section, available here:


https://www.imdb.com/user/ur201460854/reviews/

“My aim is to make historically neglected dimensions of Iranian cinema visible to a broader public,” Kaveh said. “IMDb is simply one of the platforms where this work can live—an accessible global database for researchers, viewers, and anyone tracing the cultural memory of cinema.”

Alongside his recent work on Film Genre: Tone and Ideology, Cinematic Taxonomy, and Viewership Theory, Kaveh’s contributions to IMDb form part of a larger initiative to connect Iranian film scholarship with international archival networks, ensuring that overlooked cinematic histories can be discovered and studied by new global audiences.
